title: Daily integration exceptions digest
prompt: Every business day, check for failed accounting integrations, missing postings, duplicate transactions and stale bank feeds. Send only actionable exceptions.

setup.q: Which integrations should be checked each day?
How many hours without a successful sync counts as stale?

steps: pull each integration's connection status and event log for the day
run staleness against the expected sync hours
list failed events, missing postings and duplicate transactions with severity
write only actionable exceptions; an empty day says "no exceptions" and shows the last successful sync

done.text: Every exception row cites the integration and the event id
integration-exceptions.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The last successful sync per integration is shown; unavailable data is told apart from no exceptions
